acceptance.given: A supplied FAQ entry references a local target path that cannot be resolved.

oracle.expected: The validator emits a failure identifying the FAQ dead-target violation and rejects the package.
forbidden: An FAQ entry with a dead target passes validation.
oracle.observable: Validator status and diagnostic output for the supplied FAQ dead-target case.

acceptance.then: The dead-target FAQ case is rejected with a diagnostic for the unresolved local target.
acceptance.when: Run the package validation entry point against a package containing the supplied FAQ entry and evaluate its validation result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the existing package-validation test path with a fixture whose FAQ local target is unresolved; observe the validator failure before the rejection behavior is implemented.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject supplied FAQ entries whose local targets cannot be resolved and report the dead-target diagnostic.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent schema or state change; reverting the package-validation logic restores prior behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A package containing a dead FAQ local target transitions from validation input to a rejected validation result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted package-validation test passes only when the dead-target FAQ case produces a rejection diagnostic and a failing validation result.
